purpose: Teach: ウィスキー/俵/ツル/夏期/サクサク/消しゴム/森本/くるみ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ウィスキー、年代物、頂きました。
lines.en: This aged whiskey — what a gift.
lines.style: Warm appreciation opening. Breathy, almost reverential. Soft pace. A small smile in the voice, not loud but genuine and present.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。米俵、地元の蔵元から、貰った。
lines.en: Yeah. The local brewery actually gave us those rice bales.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact. Quiet pride in the detail. Conversational pace, leaning in slightly. No performance — just sharing something real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 庭に来た野鳥、ツル、見たかも?
lines.en: Did you see a crane come through the garden? I thought I might have.
lines.style: Soft curiosity, testing the idea aloud. Hesitant — not quite sure of herself. Trailing upward slightly on the question, inviting connection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夏期、忙しくなる時期だね、お店も。
lines.en: Summer gets busy though, doesn't it? The shop gets slammed.
lines.style: Gentle observation, a little tired. Settling into the conversation. Steady pace, warm undertone — she's been thinking about this.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: クッキー、サクサクで、美味しい。
lines.en: These cookies are so crispy. Really good.
lines.style: Bright, immediate delight. Light energy but not forced. Quick pace on the pleasure of it. Genuine enjoyment without overthinking.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 子供の頃、消しゴム集めるの、好きだった。
lines.en: I used to collect erasers when I was little. I loved that.
lines.style: Soft nostalgia, a little vulnerable. Pace slows on the memory. Warm fadeout — she's touched by her own memory, not embarrassed by it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 同級生の森本さん、最近、会ってない。
lines.en: I haven't run into our classmate Morimoto in a while.
lines.style: Gentle musing, slightly wistful. Soft tone, like she's thinking out loud. Wondering where people go. No urgency — just noticing an absence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夏は、くるみ入りのケーキ、お気に入り。
lines.en: Summer's the time for that walnut cake. It's my favorite.
lines.style: Warm close, settling and satisfied. Soft conviction on the favorite part. Breath of ease at the end — contentment, like coming home to something known.
